registry.name: Meaning Conservation
registry.statement: Every admitted transformation preserves declared semantic identity across pre-state and post-state.

registry.name: Hash72/u^72 witness authority
registry.statement: Every canonical state, transition, contract, receipt, and derivation has a kernel-authorized witness.

registry.name: Full-state transition integrity
registry.statement: Control-flow decisions operate on complete pre-state, result, and post-state transitions rather than scalar proxies.

registry.name: Bounded recursive closure
registry.statement: Certification, validation, and recursive execution remain inside declared step, cycle, ledger, and artifact budgets.

registry.name: Guarded execution path
registry.statement: No runtime execution bypasses the declared contract, guard, adapter, authority, and receipt chain.

registry.name: Ledger continuity
registry.statement: Every committed state mutation has a canonical parent, receipt, ledger entry, and tip transition.

registry.name: Validation residue compression
registry.statement: Validation history is preserved as compressed witness chains rather than unbounded artifact replication.

registry.name: Canonical representation
registry.statement: Every runtime object has one declared canonical schema and deterministic serialization path.

registry.name: No hidden parallel archive
registry.statement: Carrier enhancement may preserve provenance and transformation history but cannot create undeclared duplicate payload lanes.

registry.name: Reconstruction reversibility
registry.statement: Every admitted reconstruction path declares sufficient witness information to recover or verify the canonical represented state.

registry.name: Invariant-derived admissibility
registry.statement: Admission and rejection decisions derive from kernel invariants rather than local arbitrary policy.

registry.name: Zero-bypass prohibition
registry.statement: No service, API, executor, adapter, or control-flow gate may bypass required authority or conformance stages.

registry.name: Explicit mutation ownership
registry.statement: Every state mutation declares its owning surface, persistence policy, rollback behavior, and ledger effect.

registry.name: Surface reachability closure
registry.statement: Every executable surface must be boot-, service-, API-, or control-flow reachable through a declared canonical path.

registry.name: Self-consistent derivation closure
registry.statement: The conformance map itself must be kernel-derived, witnessed, bounded, and included in the closure harness.
